normalization_audit.factor_of_two_convention: v19 uses D=G_+'(0), the half-difference endpoint convention. v20's raw plus-minus divided by a is 2D. This replay uses v19 D: the quadratic residual derivative has the explicit -2*alpha^T*b cross term, while w=b-D_old*alpha and its LDL cost receive no extra factor 2. Gain and cost are checked separately against the v19 archive so cancellation in surplus cannot mask a factor-of-two error.

parameters.reconstruction: midpoints of SHA-bound certified input intervals

scope: SHA-bound midpoint replay of the already certified original-theta odd endpoint rungs 3..19 at a=0. Archived intervals certify only the finite gain/cost/surplus claims. The emitted LDL pivots and eta coordinates are high-precision finite diagnostics, not interval certificates, an all-degree inequality, or an RH proof.
